Comment: TF2 FinOps Watch CDO daily workflow

ProcessAnalysisTargets.Comment: Process each analysis target account sequentially

Result.Cause: Tenant ad hoc run quota limit of 5 runs per day exceeded.
Billing reports (CUR) export delayed beyond 4 hours.

Parameters.Subject: FinOps Watch CUR Export Delay Alert
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('CUR billing export delayed beyond 4 hours for Run ID: {}', $.run_id)

Result.Cause: Cost ingestion returned an unexpected state or failed.
No valid gzipped S3 pointer was produced for AI detection.

ChooseDetectRequestMode.Comment: Route to RAW_JSON inline build for small CE-fallback payloads; keep S3_POINTER for CUR-ready and oversized CE payloads.

BuildDetectRequestRawJson.Comment: Inline RAW_JSON body for small CE-fallback payloads. Payload is carried in Step Functions state; VpcAlbCallerLambda sends it directly to the internal ALB.

InvokeDetect.Comment: Step Functions invokes VpcAlbCallerLambda; helper sends signed HTTPS to internal ALB; ALB invokes AI Engine Request Lambda live alias.

Result.Cause: AI Engine returned an unsuccessful or low-confidence detection response.

ProcessDetectedAnomalies.Comment: G1 fix: Process each detected anomaly sequentially (MaxConcurrency=1) to avoid parallel containment blast radius and preserve deterministic audit order.

InvokeDecideForAnomaly.Comment: Step Functions invokes VpcAlbCallerLambda for this anomaly; helper sends signed HTTPS to internal ALB; ALB invokes AI Engine Request Lambda live alias.

BuildContainmentInputForAnomaly.Comment: Flatten required top-level fields for containment worker from per-anomaly Map item context.

ReportVerifyResultForAnomaly.Comment: Step Functions invokes VpcAlbCallerLambda for this anomaly; helper sends signed HTTPS to internal ALB; ALB invokes AI Engine Request Lambda live alias.

EvaluateVerifyResultForAnomaly.Comment: Branch on verify_result.next_action: DONE|RETRY|ROLLBACK|ESCALATE per contract Section 5.

ExecuteRollbackFromCacheForAnomaly.Comment: CDO executes rollback independently from finops-rollback-cache using cached boto3_equivalent. Does not depend on AI Engine availability.

NotifyAIRollbackForAnomaly.Comment: Notify AI Engine of rollback completion via /v1/audit/{audit_id}/rollback. This is the audit completion notification, NOT rollback dispatch.

Parameters.Subject: FinOps Watch Verify Escalation Alert
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Containment verification requires escalation. Run ID: {}, Anomaly: {}, Correlation: {}', $.run_id, $.anomaly.anomaly_id, $.correlation_id)

EvaluateAnomalySummary.Comment: Mark parent run failed only when a platform failure prevents durable audit/status evidence.

Parameters.Subject: FinOps Watch Fail-Closed Alert
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('CDO daily workflow failed closed. Run ID: {}, Error: {}, Cause: {}', $.run_id, $.error.Error, $.error.Cause)

WriteContainmentFailureAudit.Comment: Legacy parent-level state kept for detection-path failures before the Map. Per-anomaly containment failures route to AnomalyPlatformFailed inside the Map.
